subject: getting best marker order using ripple

messages.author: 756a884bb45d1384
messages.subject: getting best marker order using ripple
parts:
Dear Dr. Broman,

I am Sandip Kale, working at ICRISAT, India. 

We are using a dataset of 13K SNPs for construction of linkage maps. After removing the duplicate markers, we are left with 6K SNPs.

As this is still a large number, we are trying to construct linkage map separately for each chromosome. For one of the chromosome with 2409 markers, we could not able to run orderMarkers function with ripple. So, we decided to run the markerOrders and ripple commands separately as follow:

chr1 <- orderMarkers(chr1, chr=1,use.ripple=FALSE )

rip5lik <- ripple(chr1, chr=1, window=5, method="likelihood", error.prob=0.005) 

Now, we would like to use best order from rip5lik for further estimating genetic map. 

As I am new to R and just know basic, I request you to please help me in getting best marker order.

Thanking you with best regards

Sandip

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] getting best marker order using ripple
parts:
You can use

summary(rip5lik)

to view the top marker orders from ripple.

If you want to apply the 2nd order to the cross, use

chr1 <- switch.order(chr1, chr=1, rip5lik[2,])

With many markers, as you have, I’d recommend using the default method for ripple, “countxo”, at least to start. It’s much, much faster and gives very similar results.

karl
